translations.text: Naomi said to Ruth, “Look, your sister-in-law has returned to her people and her gods. You too, my daughter, return to your sister-in-law.”
May your reward be complete from the Lord, the God of [?], to whom you have come to take refuge under his wings.
He said to her, “Who are you?” She said, “I am Ruth, your servant. Spread the edge of your cloak over your servant, because you are a close relative.”
Boaz said to her, “May you be blessed by the Lord, my daughter, because you have shown greater kindness now than before by not pursuing young men, whoever they might be, whether poor or rich.”
She said to her, “Sit down, my daughter, until you know that no word will fail. For the man will not rest until he has finished the matter today.”
Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife. He had intercourse with her, and the Lord enabled her to give birth, and she bore a son.
